label: Locate discriminating input in agenda selection and compare motivated choice
summary: At 561ba7d5 mapped complete proposed selection inputs into the existing noUnique selector obstruction and WholeSeriesChoicePolicies agenda certificate. A transported agenda changes the complete input; equal option value alone does not fix it. Preserved the moved-output condition, genuinely distinct outcome requirement, and the difference between a symmetric distribution and a unique realization. Clarke Fifth Reply §§1–20 supplies a positive motivated-agency comparison; no source claim or formal attribution added. Distinguished reasons to act, contrastive reasons and actual practical governance. The agenda explains a procedure under its order, while its authority and any divine application remain open; nonnecessitating agency is neither refuted nor identified with chance. At ec72649fb completed the #1570 governance test in docs/notes/explanatory-symmetry-742.md under Did the reason guide production of this order?. Matched dispatches separate a content-derived instruction used in production from an independent booking rule with the same later report; only the former stops on disconnect. A direct impersonal selector survives a correction of the booking just as the edited route does. At a tie the end warrants either eligible output. Actual basing and object-specific adoption motivate a conditional authorship advantage. Both productive origins can improve on brute actuality under whole-order explanation; identifying a rational power leaves its operative apprehended specification at this exercise open. The next discriminator is a same-giver constitutive account against common-source contemplation and value-sensitive production. No new result, premise closure or personality inference. Applied the reviewed dispatch comparison to Darwin abandoning the marine-origin claim for the Parallel Roads. The new Glen Roy section compares two sources of this very embodied knower’s continued existence, with identical geological and local rational resources. A finite terrain/report construction distinguishes responding to a report from always giving the same answer. Copying an externally computed verdict can match every answer and its accuracy gain. At the source the construction distinguishes use of a supplied instruction from bypassing it. The identity of a contemplating giver and its adoption of Darwin’s good require separate grounds. Contemporaneous selective engagement favors basing. Neither the correction nor the identity of the power decides whether the giver sustained Darwin for his own epistemic good. The earlier published assessment at b559b9d12da12d91f44f093740eb81b38f562927 covers the dispatch only. The original Glen Roy note was committed at fa333246066fe7c9fa76d99112adc85fc29bc227. Independent challenge of the complete draft at d88e02325f09e5f7a6cae5b50463d875aed9d510 accepted the historical assessment, counts, and transfer limits, and requested narrower claims about accuracy, instruction use and explanatory scope. The prior dispatch assessment was independently accepted at b559b9d12da12d91f44f093740eb81b38f562927. Independent recheck accepted the complete Glen Roy note and attempt at 826535a6cdc4c6f1b0ee94c17c2dc49dc569ff6b. It reproduced all 80 matched answers under an external verdict and the zero-gain tie with an uninformative report, and accepted the limited historical and philosophical conclusion. PR #1981 merged into main at 10653e8d824cf012d376b2e99595ed649d969d1c. The Apollo 13 continuation checked the flight directors’ joint postflight narrative of the selection meeting and the retrofire team’s joint postflight report of the on-duty officer’s no-go against the contemporaneous Kerwin–Haise exchange. The chosen mission objective, uptake and correction discriminate local practical roles. At a simple ultimate giver the original authority argument is conditional on an understood specification being operative. Even purposive production of the whole leaves the end for this recipient open.

current_assessment.scope: Apollo 13 as evidence of the producer’s practical use of a target, and its bearing on why one simple giver sustains Darwin for his own good.
current_assessment.assessment: The mission records favor purposive human contributions at selection and implementation, including the operational reason the retrofire team’s joint postflight report attributes to the officer on duty. Original adoption explains how an understood end could govern one simple giving without an external planner. A reason-responsive productive nature can secure the same opportunity, and the same giver could understand the nature’s exercise perfectly without the understanding directing it. The existence and good of this recipient alone favor neither ultimate account. Even intended production of the whole order leaves the recipient’s benefit as an intended end or a foreseen consequence.
current_assessment.next_test: Test whether the mode in which the giver contains and knows the effect must be the mode in which it produces the effect. If productive understanding is warranted, identify grounds for including this recipient’s good among the ends of the giving under strict intrinsic invariance. A mere forecast, successful production and a rational power each leave this open.
current_assessment.evidence: Flight Control Division, Mission Operations Report, III-22–23 and Appendix B p. B-12 §E.1–2, and Haise–Kerwin at 070:55:52–070:57:32. ST I q.14 a.8 and q.19 aa.4–5 distinguish inclination, direction and the order of ends within one act. The earlier reviews cover the Darwin and dispatch findings only. Independent challenge at 572078c7b0d167acbb8d0f131e9b9a53c9d00f72 accepted the philosophical comparison and requested a postflight attribution correction. The targeted recheck accepted both records at 92cf7cddba9681fc8979642007b8e055155358c2.
current_assessment.supersedes: Takes up the Glen Roy next test about deriving a practical object from the giver’s own operation. Its reviewed conclusion about Darwin’s selective uptake and the two accounts of his continued existence stands at 826535a6cdc4c6f1b0ee94c17c2dc49dc569ff6b.
